comment: The knob is ±5V and the CV is summed with it before a single clamp, so the pair behaves as one control clamped to ±5V rather than as a knob with an attenuated CV. The README says the CV input is polyphonic, which it is, but it is read against the in jack's channel count: a mono CV cable leaves every channel past the first following the knob alone.
